physicalNotes: Radius 1.046 Jupiter radii from del Burgo et al. 2026 (2026ApJ..1003L..15D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1003L..15D/abstract): 74,780.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: del Burgo et al. 2026 (2026ApJ..1003L..15D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1003L..15D/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 1.6 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
